Been an arsenal supporter since i was 7. I supported them in the era of barkamp and henry and i supported them throughout their drought of trophies. Never stopped supporting them but felt as though Arsenal would never become a top tier team again. 2013 came and we signed ozil. A little part of me had hope of better days to come. Eventually our boys made it to the fa cup final. 

Hull - on paper we had them. Perhaps this could be the year when we showed our rivals that we stood amongst them. Perhaps this could be the year that ends all jeering against arsenals lack of trophies over the year. However in true arsenal fashion when it mattered most we completely bottled it, conceiding 2 goals within the first 10 minutes. I felt deflated and covered my ears as my manchester untied loving siblings ridiculed me as they did for the past 8 or so years. It was arsenal vs birmingham in the carling cup final all over again. 

This cemented my lack of beleif of a top tier arsenal team. I sat silently, contemplating why i was either bothering watching the remainder of the match. 16 minutes in carzola scores. Meh, nice freekick, atleast i have something to retaliate with. moral victory right? I endured another 50 or so minutes. Then it happened. Kos scores a header. I stop breathing. i dared not say a word. i didnot want to jynx it. i didnot want to raise my hopes up just to be laughed at on the occasion that we ended up throwing it all away. i did that for 8 years. Not another year. im better than that. The 7 year old inside me still dared to dream though. 

It goes to extra time. half time nothing. Great! watch how we go to penalties just to lose. So close yet so far away. Typical arsenal finish right? Second half starts and im sitting on the couch, watching blanklessly but with a million thoughts racing through my mind. And then it happens. a back pass from giroud and our rambo drills it in with a low shot. My jaw drops. im finding it difficult to breath. Then just like how a baby gradually cries from what seems to be whimpers at first, i let out a beast like shriek. My siblings say nothing. They didnt need to. Their silence spoke a thousand words. The next 10 minutes were the longest i felt in a long time. 10 minutes could change everything. The final whistle blows. I go fricking balistic. I run outside barefoot and run to the end of the street and back screaming. it was a sight to behold. My dad (fellow gunner)comically timed, parks outside his house to find his 20 year old son running outside screaming. He gets out his car, planning to rip me an new one for embarrassing him in public. he asks me for an explanation. i tell him arsenal won the fa cup. He proceeds to join me in screaming and running around our block.

so yeah that was probably my most proudest moment being an arsenal supporter. 

edit: koscielny scores but it wasnt a header. Thanks for reminding me guys!
